fact: On 10 July 2025 the minister announced a Ivorian technology innovation fund with initial capital of FCFA 100 billion to finance startups selected through the labelling committee.
title: Côte d’Ivoire-AIP/ Ivoire tech forum : un fonds Ivoirien de l’innovation technologique de 100 milliards F CFA pour financer les startups (Ministre)
